newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Hoogovens 1996 net profit sharply lower.
newsitem.headline: Hoogovens 1996 net profit sharply lower.

text.p: Dutch steel and aluminium group Hoogovens NV said on Thursday its 1996 net profit fell sharply to 326 million guilders from 507 million in 1995.
The company said it would pay a dividend of 3.00 guilders per share, unchanged from 1995.
The results came in above the range of analyst forecasts which predicted net profit from ordinary operating at between 260 and 310 million guilders.
The company also said it expected net profit from ordinary operations to improve in the course of 1997.
It said the recovery in Europe was expected to result in moderate economic growth in 1997, which would have a positive impact on demand for steel and aluminium products.
Hoogovens shares were 6.60 guilders higher at 97.60 guilders in early trade.
